# Offline thread member conversion

This macOS/APFS operator tool is built only with `-tags floret_layout_cutover`. It converts a stopped format-6 layout to format 7 with format-2 members. It does not contact a provider. Do not open either layout with a runtime during the procedure.

1. Stop the owning Host and its launcher. Confirm the entrance, catalog, members and their SQLite companions are not in use. Reserve sufficient space on the same APFS volume for a complete independent backup, another working snapshot, a candidate and temporary SQLite work. Select new private directories whose parents are trusted; use absolute, non-symlink paths.
2. Run `python3 scripts/testdata/thread-member-cutover/snapshot.py "$LIVE" "$BACKUP"`. It locks the entrance, clones the files, checks identity and verifies all digests before writing `snapshot.json`. Preserve the entire backup read-only. Re-run the snapshot command with the backup entrance and a new working directory to obtain writable clones. Never open the backup as the path of a writer.
3. Build the tool once from the reviewed source: `GOWORK=off go build -tags floret_layout_cutover -o "$PRIVATE_BIN" ./scripts/testdata/thread-member-cutover`. Run `"$PRIVATE_BIN" prepare "$WORK/$NAME" "$STAGE"`, where `NAME` is the live entrance basename. The destination must not exist. Every live member must pass canonical and public-projection comparisons; check the thread and tombstone counts in `prepared.json`. A failed or interrupted preparation is not installable; start preparation in a fresh empty location after addressing the cause.
4. Rehearse the installation and `verify-window` on an independent clone. To install the approved candidate on the stopped live layout, run `"$PRIVATE_BIN" install "$LIVE" "$STAGE"`. Both entrances are locked and both layouts must exactly match the preparation seals. The tool exchanges the directories, synchronizes their parents, then exchanges the entrances and synchronizes again. Between the exchanges runtime opens fail closed. If interrupted at that boundary, keep both trees unchanged and re-run `install` to finish. A completed install is not replayable. After an I/O or synchronization error, inspect both locations and their seals with the Host stopped; do not open a mixed layout or manually splice members.
5. Run `"$PRIVATE_BIN" verify-window "$LIVE" "$THREAD"` on the intended thread with the Host still stopped. The public Host requests a bounded window and a summary with execution deferred. Only then start the new application. Keep the sealed source backup; the exchanged old layout also remains in the staging directory. Rollback requires stopping the new Host and deliberately restoring the **entire** source layout together with a matching application; it does not merge writes made after the switch.
